description: Source code for the ServerRequest class in GuzzleHttp PSR7 library, implementing server-side HTTP request handling with methods for accessing request data, headers, URI, and uploaded files.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Represents a server-side HTTP request, extending the Request class to include server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and request attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ServerRequest with method, URI, headers, body, protocol version, and server parameters.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes an array of uploaded files to ensure they conform to the expected interface.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a $_FILES specification array.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Normalizes nested file specifications into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object populated with PHP superglobals ($_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $_SERVER).

methods.name: extractHostAndPortFromAuthority
methods.description: Extracts host and port from a URI authority string.

methods.name: getUriFromGlobals
methods.description: Constructs a URI object based on server environment variables.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns server parameters ($_SERVER).

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns uploaded files array.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Returns cookie parameters.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns query parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified parsed body.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns request attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute or default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specific attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without a specific attribute.
